theme_description: A professional resource portal template for managing digital assets and media files. It supports multi-level channel navigation, tag organization, advanced filtering, and robust permission controls.

logo_url.label: Logo image
logo_url.info: If a logo is configured, the header shows the logo; otherwise it shows the site icon and site name.

company_name.label: Company Name
company_name.info: Displayed in the footer area at the bottom of the page.

head_html.label: Custom HTML in <head></head>
head_html.info: Supports HTML tags and limited Tailwind CSS styles.
head_html.placeholder: Typically used for analytics scripts, support widgets, or other embed codes.

header_menu_html.label: Insert HTML in the top navigation area
header_menu_html.info: Supports HTML tags and limited Tailwind CSS styles.
header_menu_html.placeholder: Typically used to add navigation links to other company websites.

footer_html.label: Insert HTML in the footer area
footer_html.info: Supports HTML tags and limited Tailwind CSS styles; this completely replaces the default footer content.
footer_html.placeholder: To keep the default footer content, insert HTML in footer_menu_html instead.

footer_menu_html.label: Insert HTML in the bottom area (inside footer_menu_html)
footer_menu_html.info: Supports HTML tags and limited Tailwind CSS styles.
footer_menu_html.placeholder: Typically used for external links, partner links, and SEO-friendly footer links.

index.name: Home
index.description: Display all channels in a list

resource_download_expiry_time.label: Resource download link validity (seconds)
resource_download_expiry_time.info: Unit: seconds; 0 means never expires. Preview image TTL is fixed at 7200 seconds.

api_host.label: API host
api_host.info: API host for batch upload and related features. If empty, it is inferred as open.* (e.g. open.baklib.com).
